description: Figure 8b, located in the top-right quadrant of the 4-plot grid, is titled “The performance on Llama2.” It is a line plot illustrating the relationship between “Co-occurrence Number” on the x-axis and “ACC (%)” on the y-axis for different knowledge editing methods applied to the Llama2 model. The x-axis is logarithmic, ranging from 1 to 1000, with labeled ticks at 1, 10, 100, and 1000. The y-axis is linear, ranging from 60% to 85%, with labeled ticks at 60, 65, 70, 75, 80, and 85. The plot contains five lines, each representing a different editing method: “Base” (black with circle markers), “MEND” (brown with square markers), “FT” (blue with triangle markers), “MEMIT” (purple with diamond markers), and “ROME” (green with square markers). All lines show an upward trend as the co-occurrence number increases. At a co-occurrence number of 1, the Base method starts at approximately 63%, FT at 65%, MEMIT at 68%, MEND at 70%, and ROME at 73%. At a co-occurrence number of 1000, the Base method reaches approximately 70%, FT reaches 72%, MEMIT reaches 76%, MEND reaches 78%, and ROME reaches 82%. The ROME method consistently achieves the highest accuracy across all co-occurrence numbers, while the Base method remains the lowest.
